findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the ice machine to have a build up of soils around the mechanical parts of the ice machine. Discussed with PIC, and PIC cleaned and sanitized the pieces that were soiled. Ensure the machine is cleaned and sanitized regularly enough to keep it clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Triple sink was observed to be dripping from faucet. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that faucets are constructed properly and do not drip water.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the hand sink for the bar to be missing a supply of disposable towels. Towels were provided to the hand sink. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Inspector observed no soap at the bar hand sink at time of inspection. Soap was provided to the hand sink. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed cloth towels on top of smooth cleanable stainless surfaces with ice scoops stored on top of the towels. Remove towels and store food contact surfaces clean on top of sanitized smooth surfaces. 

4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be safe. P Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Food handler certificates are not available at time of inspection. The facility person in charge was unaware of the need for handler certification. Provide handler certifications for all bartenders/food handlers. 

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-204.11: (A)-(B): Chemical SANITIZERS applied for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall meet regulatory requirements. 

Observed facility to have incorrect bleach - for laundry use only. Bleach must be for food-contact surfaces, have an EPA registration number, and information regarding parts per million (ppm) content. Inspector will follow-up on 6/7/21.
